description: Execution-policy clarification for the blinded semantic Pass B rater defined in STAGE1_QUALITY_PROTOCOL_V1. This artifact changes NO scientific role: Pass B remains the blinded semantic rater in the quality protocol. It only freezes that Pass B is diagnostic, is not part of the Stage-1 generation budget, and requires separate human spend authorization.
pass_b_cannot: change the Stage-1 structural PASS/FAIL gate
primary_gate_computed_by: src/research/item6/stage1_gate.py evaluate_gate() consuming src/research/item6/stage1_metrics.py Stage1Endpoints, which are computed from the deterministic formalizer + baseline-equivalence detector + deterministic family-signature dedup. Neither stage1_gate.py nor stage1_metrics.py imports quality_protocol (Pass B).

pass_b_future_authorization_contract.note: A future Pass B run is a SEPARATE experiment step requiring its own human spend authorization. That authorization must freeze ALL of the following before any paid diagnostic call.
must_freeze: rater prompt (blinded; sees only pre-target packet + mechanism + evidence refs + coverage spec)
spend guard + monetary ceiling (separate from the Stage-1 generation ceiling)
blinding manifest (proof OOS/markets/settlement/ARM-D performance are not visible)
